title: Python decode_rule255 applies endpoint address policy on receipt, violating spec 03 TX/RX split; diverges from Rust RX
description: P1, found by worker5 probe during project-LICHEN-worker6-1jbb verification. spec/03-adaptation.md:426-429 (canonical TX/RX split, landed faed8ccfb5): 'Rule 255 DECODING is byte-preserving and MUST validate structure and checksums only: a decoder MUST NOT apply the endpoint address policy on receipt, because a structurally valid packet already on the link is preserved verbatim rather than dropped as malformed. This split keeps the two implementation families interoperable: a packet one implementation cannot originate is still delivered intact by the other.' Python python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py decode_rule255 -> validate_full_ipv6 still runs _validate_ipv6_addresses (rejects unspecified src, multicast src, unspecified dst) AND UdpDatagram.from_bytes(payload, src) re-checks malformed sources (python/src/lichen/ipv6/udp.py:96-97) on the RX path. Rust RX decode_rule255 -> validate_full_ipv6_structure (codec.rs:1464) applies NO address checks (spec-compliant). Probe (valid UDP checksum, independent RFC 1071 oracle): src=:: / src=ff02::1 / dst=:: -> Python decode_rule255 REJECTS (invalid IPv6 source/destination address), Rust ACCEPTS byte-preserving - identical on-air bytes, opposite verdicts, same class as the k0r2 break for the loopback/v4mapped/scope classes wlts fixed. Also inflates RuleVersionFailureTracker misbehaving-peer notifications on Python nodes. wlts close incorrectly recorded 'Python verified aligned: decode_rule255:212 runs structural validation only' - the split was only verified for the 5 loopback/v4mapped/scope classes; the 3 unspecified/multicast-source classes still hit _validate_ipv6_addresses first. Fix: split decode from the full validator on the Python side the way Rust did (decode_rule255 must call a structure+checksums-only validator: version/length/next-header/chain/UDP length/checksum over RFC 2460 s8.1 dst, NO _validate_ipv6_addresses, NO UdpDatagram.from_bytes malformed-source check, keep UdpDatagram length/zero-checksum structure checks), keep validate_full_ipv6 (TX) enforcing the full emission policy; then add the 3 missing corpus rows (source ::, source ff02::1, destination ::) to schc_adaptation.json rule255_endpoint_policy with expect_valid=false (they currently cannot be committed: python false-branch asserts decode byte-preservation and would fail), and rerun parity + adaptation suites in both impls.
close_reason: Fixed: Python decode_rule255 is now byte-preserving per spec/03-adaptation.md canonical TX/RX split, matching Rust. Changes: (1) new _validate_ipv6_structure (headers.py:138) enforces version/length/ext-header chain/UDP length/zero-checksum refusal/checksum over RFC 2460 s8.1 upper-layer dst - NO _validate_ipv6_addresses, NO UdpDatagram malformed-source check (from_bytes called WITHOUT src so the endpoint check never fires; length/zero-checksum structure checks kept); (2) decode_rule255 calls it and returns data[1:] verbatim; (3) validate_full_ipv6 = structure + _validate_ipv6_addresses, TX semantics unchanged (the old from_bytes(payload, src) malformed-source check was redundant on TX - _validate_ipv6_addresses rejected the same classes first, so no behavior delta); (4) unspecified-dst TX message aligned to canonical 'invalid IPv6 destination address <addr>' (was 'invalid unspecified IPv6 destination address', headers.py:87, matching Rust codec.rs:255 and the vector mapping); (5) 3 corpus rows added to schc_adaptation.json rule255_endpoint_policy (rx_byte_preserving unspecified source / multicast source / unspecified destination, expect_valid=false, expect_error codes mapped in both impls) with expected_counts 8->11. Verification on heft: python adaptation 67/67 (3 new rows green), full test_vectors 770/770, python/tests/schc 1377/1377; ruff check+format clean; RUST adaptation_vectors.rs consumed the same JSON green (2/2, count equality assert 11==11 at :1468) and all 14 lichen-schc integration targets green under their feature sets. 3x delegated codereview: correctness PASS (TX union preserved - both validate_full_ipv6 call sites followed by emission check; zero stale old-text references; counts/coverage consistent), security PASS (checksum + RH3 structure intact; downstream DIO-ingest screening question filed as separate P3), edge PASS (bytearray/type behavior identical, boundary handling moved not altered, no return-value reliance).
